shortDescription: Coca-Cola NYSE:KO is seeking to unwind its $5 billion acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee after a sales process failed earlier this year, Semafor reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.Reuters could not independently verify the report.
